Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Sell smarter. Buy smarter. Learn your trading style.
Description: One FFXIV Market Board suite containing Should I Sell?, Should I Buy?, and Should I Tycoon?: selling guidance, budget-aware opportunity scanning, vendor and stack arbitrage analysis, confirmed purchase cost-basis capture, personal sales history, and trader performance analytics.
Changelog:
# Should I? v1.1.5

Improves practical **Should I Buy?** execution and expands **Should I Tycoon?** personal-market learning.

## Buy execution model
- Models one active Market Board listing per item/HQ variant when judging capital deployment.
- Adds one-listing capital recovery and sequential listing-cycle pressure so huge cheap stockpiles are not overrated by eventual full-liquidation profit.
- Vendor → Market now tops up one working listing and avoids recommending unnecessary warehoused stock.
- Enforces FFXIV's 99-unit Market Board listing maximum across Buy execution and the shared Sell stack engine.

## Native Deep Scan
- Fresh FFXIV ItemSearch data now re-rates visible Buy opportunities.
- Exact acquisition listing ID, price and quantity are verified for market-sensitive packages.
- Changed packages are demoted; valid fresh snapshots update exit price, stack, confidence, ROI, profit, liquidity and rating.

## Tycoon insights
- Adds Sales Insights across all captured personal retainer sales.
- Adds Listing Insights for observed repricing, stack-size changes, relists and time-to-sale.
- Unknown purchase cost remains unknown instead of inventing profit for gathered, crafted, dropped, gifted or pre-tracking stock.
